SELECT e.emp_no, e.first_name, e.last_name
FROM employees e
JOIN salaries s ON e.emp_no = s.emp_no
WHERE s.to_date = '9999-01-01'
  AND e.emp_no NOT IN (
    SELECT emp_no
    FROM (
      SELECT emp_no, MAX(to_date) AS max_to_date
      FROM salaries
      GROUP BY emp_no
    ) AS max_salaries
    WHERE max_to_date < (
      SELECT to_date
      FROM salaries
      WHERE emp_no = max_salaries.emp_no
        AND to_date = '9999-01-01'
    )
  )

SELECT e.emp_no, 
       (s2.salary - s1.salary) * 100.0 / s1.salary AS salary_increase_percentage
FROM employees e
JOIN salaries s1 ON e.emp_no = s1.emp_no
JOIN salaries s2 ON e.emp_no = s2.emp_no
WHERE s2.to_date = '9999-01-01' AND s1.to_date = '9999-01-01'
ORDER BY e.emp_no

SELECT d.dept_name FROM departments d
JOIN dept_emp de ON d.dept_no = de.dept_no
WHERE de.to_date = '9999-01-01'
GROUP BY d.dept_name
HAVING COUNT(de.emp_no) > (SELECT AVG(COUNT(emp_no)) FROM dept_emp WHERE to_date = '9999-01-01')
SELECT emp_no FROM titles GROUP BY emp_no HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT title) > (SELECT AVG(COUNT(DISTINCT title)) FROM titles)

SELECT d.dept_name, AVG(s.salary) 
FROM departments d 
JOIN dept_emp de ON d.dept_no = de.dept_no 
JOIN salaries s ON de.emp_no = s.emp_no 
GROUP BY d.dept_name

SELECT d.dept_name, MAX(s.salary) - MIN(s.salary) AS salary_difference
FROM departments d
JOIN dept_emp de ON d.dept_no = de.dept_no
JOIN salaries s ON de.emp_no = s.emp_no
WHERE s.to_date = '9999-01-01'
GROUP BY d.dept_name
ORDER BY salary_difference DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT e.emp_no, e.first_name, e.last_name FROM employees e
LEFT JOIN titles t ON e.emp_no = t.emp_no
LEFT JOIN dept_emp de ON e.emp_no = de.emp_no
WHERE t.to_date = '9999-01-01' AND de.to_date = '9999-01-01'

SELECT d.dept_name, m.emp_no, m.from_date, m.to_date
FROM departments d
JOIN dept_manager dm ON d.dept_no = dm.dept_no
JOIN employees m ON dm.emp_no = m.emp_no
GROUP BY d.dept_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT m.emp_no) > 2
SELECT strftime('%Y', hire_date) AS year, COUNT(emp_no) AS num_employees FROM employees WHERE strftime('%Y', hire_date) BETWEEN '1985' AND '1989' GROUP BY year
SELECT dept_no FROM dept_emp WHERE strftime('%Y', from_date) BETWEEN '1985' AND '1989' GROUP BY dept_no HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT strftime('%Y', from_date)) = 5

SELECT emp_no FROM titles WHERE emp_no IN (
    SELECT emp_no FROM titles
    GROUP BY emp_no
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
)
SELECT AVG(salary) FROM salaries WHERE to_date = '9999-01-01' ORDER BY salary LIMIT 1 OFFSET (SELECT COUNT(*) / 2 - 1 FROM salaries WHERE to_date = '9999-01-01')
SELECT emp_no FROM salaries WHERE salary > (SELECT MAX(salary) FROM salaries WHERE emp_no = 10001)

SELECT d.dept_name, CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN e.gender = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(e.emp_no) AS female_percentage
FROM departments d
JOIN dept_emp de ON d.dept_no = de.dept_no
JOIN employees e ON de.emp_no = e.emp_no
WHERE de.to_date = '9999-01-01'
GROUP BY d.dept_name

SELECT d.dept_name, e.first_name, e.last_name, e.salary
FROM dept_manager dm
JOIN employees e ON dm.emp_no = e.emp_no
JOIN departments d ON dm.dept_no = d.dept_no
JOIN salaries s ON e.emp_no = s.emp_no
WHERE s.to_date = '9999-01-01'
  AND e.salary > (SELECT AVG(salary) FROM salaries WHERE to_date = '9999-01-01' AND emp_no IN (SELECT emp_no FROM dept_manager WHERE to_date = '9999-01-01'))

SELECT e.emp_no, e.first_name, e.last_name, t.title, t.from_date, t.to_date
FROM employees e
JOIN titles t ON e.emp_no = t.emp_no
WHERE t.to_date - t.from_date > 5 * 365

JOIN dept_emp de ON d.dept_no = de.dept_no
JOIN salaries s ON de.emp_no = s.emp_no
WHERE s.to_date = '9999-01-01'
GROUP BY d.dept_name
